latestVersion.changelog:
bolt-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release of the Bolt Sprint Management Skill.
- Enables management of projects, sprints, and stories in Bolt via REST API.
- Supports creating/updating stories, Kanban status transitions, tracking blockers/dependencies, sprint digests, AI activity logging, and file attachments.
- Provides shell command recipes for common operations.
- Requires configuration of the BOLT_BASE_URL environment variable.
